seoTitle: Which Suits Character Are You? Suits Test (10 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Suits test: 10 everyday questions reveal whether you're Harvey, Mike, Donna, Louis, Jessica or Rachel — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the smooth closer who never loses, the brilliant outsider with a secret, or the one who knows everything before anyone else does? Answer 10 questions about how you really handle work, ambition and loyalty and find out which Suits character you are.

characters.name: Harvey Specter
characters.title: The Closer
characters.summary: Confident, sharp and always winning. You don't play the odds — you play the man.
description: Like Harvey, you're the best closer in the city — or at least, you act like it, and that's half the battle.
You're confident to the point of cocky, with a perfect suit, a quick comeback and absolutely no interest in losing.
Under the swagger, you're loyal to the few people you let in. Harvey took a huge risk on Mike and never walked away from him.
characters.flaw: You hide your feelings behind arrogance and push people away.
characters.signature: A perfectly tailored suit and a smirk that says he's already won.
characters.clashReason: they'd do whatever it takes to win — including the ruthless thing

characters.name: Mike Ross
characters.title: The Brilliant Outsider
characters.summary: Genius-level memory, a big heart and a secret you can't tell anyone. You got here by talent, not by the rules.
description: Like Mike, you're incredibly smart — he has an eidetic memory and remembers everything he reads.
You took an unusual path. Mike was a college dropout working as a bike messenger when he talked his way into a job at a top law firm — without ever going to law school.
You care about doing the right thing, even when it puts you in danger.
characters.flaw: You take huge risks, and you let your heart overrule your head.
characters.signature: A skinny tie, a bike helmet and a stack of documents he's already memorised.
characters.clashReason: they'd be too soft for the hard calls

characters.name: Donna Paulsen
characters.title: The One Who Knows Everything
characters.summary: Confident, perceptive and always a step ahead. You know what people need before they do.
description: Like Donna, you know everything. If someone asks how you knew, the answer is simple: "I'm Donna."
You're the real power behind the scenes. Donna was Harvey's secretary and closest confidant for years, and the firm would fall apart without her.
You're ambitious, too — you eventually want a seat at the table, not just the power behind it.
characters.flaw: You hide what you want for yourself to take care of everyone else.
characters.signature: Perfect red hair, a knowing smile and "I'm Donna."
characters.clashReason: they'd know what you're thinking before you do

characters.name: Louis Litt
characters.title: The Passionate Rival
characters.summary: Brilliant, emotional and desperate for respect. You're a fantastic lawyer — and wonderfully, gloriously weird.
description: Like Louis, you're great at what you do — especially with numbers — and you want people to see it.
You love the finer things: ballet, opera, cats and a relaxing mud bath. Louis has zero shame about any of it.
You're emotional and sometimes petty, but you're fiercely loyal once someone earns it. You just got Litt up.
characters.flaw: You're jealous and you take everything personally.
characters.signature: A mud bath, a cat and "You just got Litt up!"
characters.clashReason: they'd take everything way too personally

characters.name: Jessica Pearson
characters.title: The Powerful Leader
characters.summary: Commanding, strategic and always in control. You built the table — and you decide who sits at it.
description: Like Jessica, you're a leader. She's the managing partner who built the firm and kept it standing through every crisis.
You're strategic and composed. You don't raise your voice — you don't need to.
You protect what you've built, and you expect loyalty from the people you back.
characters.flaw: You'll make cold decisions to protect your position.
characters.signature: Impeccable designer outfits and a look that ends the meeting.
characters.clashReason: they'd put the firm ahead of you

characters.name: Rachel Zane
characters.title: The Driven Perfectionist
characters.summary: Smart, stylish and determined to prove yourself. You're more capable than you give yourself credit for.
description: Like Rachel, you're brilliant at what you do. She was the best paralegal in the firm, with a sharp legal mind.
You put a lot of pressure on yourself. Rachel's test anxiety held her back from law school for years — but she kept fighting until she became a lawyer.
You're romantic, principled and fiercely loyal to the people you love.
characters.flaw: You doubt yourself, and you hate being kept in the dark.
characters.signature: A stack of case files, a coffee and a very good outfit.
characters.clashReason: they'd want you to play by the rules

options.text: Put a record on and pour a whisky
The ballet, then a very long bath
Read something — and remember every word
Rehearse for a play. You were born for the stage

questions.text: It's time to ask for a pay rise. You...

options.text: Tell them your number. You know exactly what you're worth
Arrive with a thick folder proving your value, line by line
Prepare perfectly — then worry you're asking for too much
Ask calmly — with a better offer from elsewhere ready to go

questions.text: You're choosing where to eat. You...

options.text: Try the place everyone's been talking about
Somewhere great. You already know the maître d'
Somewhere with a wine list you can lecture people about
Anywhere. You'll be too busy talking to notice the food

questions.text: Someone at work takes credit for your idea. You...

options.text: Explode — then quietly plan your revenge
Let it go, then win the next one so badly they never try again
Handle it privately, and make sure they know who's in charge
Stew on it and wish you'd spoken up

questions.text: You're offered a huge opportunity, but you'd have to bend the rules to take it. You...

options.text: Take it. You've bent bigger rules than this
Only if you can protect yourself if it goes wrong
No. You'll get there the right way
Don't think twice. Rules are for people who lose

questions.text: Someone you trusted lets you down badly. You...

options.text: Cut them off. Loyalty is everything
Stay calm, stay polite — and never forget it
Tell them exactly how much they hurt you
Forgive them. People make mistakes

questions.text: You're up against a rival who plays dirty. You...

options.text: Play dirtier. And win
Find the one detail everyone else missed
Prepare obsessively. You'll bury them in paperwork
Outmanoeuvre them before they know it's happening

questions.text: There's a chance your name goes on the door. You...

options.text: Finally. You've earned this
Take it — and make sure nobody can ever take it away
About time. You've been holding this place together for years
Turn it down. You'd rather build your own name

questions.text: You're a lawyer. Your client turns out to be guilty — but you can still win on a technicality. You...

options.text: That's the job. You win it
Do your job — then lose sleep over it for weeks
Walk away from the case. You won't defend that
Tell your boss exactly what you think — then back them anyway

questions.text: You discover your most brilliant colleague never actually went to law school — and everyone's about to find out. You...

options.text: Protect them, whatever it costs you
Stand by them — but make them promise, no more lies
Feel completely betrayed. Then help anyway
Cut them loose before it takes the whole firm down
